item.title: Community Resources
item.description:
Meshtastic and downloads

  • Meshtastic.org — The official Meshtastic website.
  • All downloads — Find Meshtastic apps and firmware.
  • Web Flasher — Install firmware on supported radios from your browser.
  • iOS app — Meshtastic for Apple devices.
  • Android app — Meshtastic on Google Play.
  • Firmware on GitHub — Source code and firmware releases.
  • Donate to Meshtastic — Support the project and its development through Open Collective.

Hardware and community guides

  • Meshware — Compare Meshtastic hardware, features, and specifications to find your next node.
  • awesome-meshtastic — A curated collection of Meshtastic guides, hardware, software, maps, and projects.

Presentations

  • What’s so fantastic about Meshtastic? by KO6CNT. Presented to PAARA on June 6, 2024.
  • Meshtastic at Benicia Amateur Radio Club by Jon Davis, KJ6FNQ.
  • Meshtastic pitch deck by Jon Davis, KJ6FNQ. An introduction used for presentations and in-person events such as Maker Faire.
